profile.name: Luminos 电动精密位移台轴模块
profile.description: Luminos 电动精密位移台轴模块是一类用于精密定位的机电运动单元，可作为线性轴（X、Y、Z）或旋转轴（滚转、偏航、俯仰）组成多自由度位移台。它常用于实验室中对样品、光学元件、探针或夹具进行高精度移动、对准、调焦和扫描。
profile.description_en: The Luminos motorized precision stage axis is an electromechanical positioning module used for fine motion control. It can serve as a linear axis (X, Y, Z) or a rotary axis (roll, yaw, pitch) within a multi-axis stage system. It is commonly used in laboratories for precise movement, alignment, focusing, and scanning of samples, optical components, probes, or fixtures.
